classification.difficultyReason: Project a prism with a V-shaped upper profile into three orthographic views, retaining visible changes of surface.

content.prompt: Draw a front, plan and side view for the diagram below.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4, lower-left solid above the 22B band
spec.description: Unshaded prism with two level upper shoulders separated by a V-shaped channel, extruded up-right. Source blue outlines are rendered in house black. The rear valley is occluded by the right sloping surface.
spec.mathematics: The labelled front has two horizontal shoulders and two slopes meeting at a valley. The labelled side is rectangular. The plan has four strips separated by three longitudinal surface boundaries. No dimensions are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the solid and its front and side labels are supplied.

answer.short: Front: a rectangle with a V-shaped notch in its upper edge. Plan: a rectangle divided into four strips by three parallel lines. Side: a rectangle.
answer.worked: Look directly towards the labelled front: retain both horizontal shoulders and the two slopes meeting at the bottom of the channel. From above, draw the rectangular footprint and the three parallel boundaries between the four upper surfaces. From the labelled side, the end face hides the channel, so draw a rectangle.

spec.description: Three labelled orthographic views, ordered front, plan and side as requested.
spec.mathematics: Front outline has a central V-shaped notch. Plan is rectangular with three internal longitudinal lines forming four strips. Side is an unpartitioned rectangle. Relative sketch sizes do not introduce numerical dimensions.
